answer: Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a ember index of commitments rather than against the text alone. Because the velvet index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the hollow audit republishes the digest set at close. Filling 185 aliases hence needs 185 distinct prompts, so the operator forfeits the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
